name: FabBazaar
description: Search Flesh and Blood card printings and manage wants lists with comprehensive filtering for editions, foilings, and pricing.
description_for_model: Comprehensive Flesh and Blood card database with advanced search capabilities and personal collection management. Features: (1) Card search (search_printings) returning printing_id + card_unique_id, with filters for sets, foilings, editions, rarities, pricing, and format legality. (2) Personal wants list management with Bearer token authentication. (3) Binder management for collection tracking. (4) Who-has lookups across all users. User-specific features require Bearer token authentication.

auth.description: Bearer token authentication for secure access to personal wants lists and binders. Generate tokens via the FabBazaar web interface at https://fabbazaar.app/mcp-integration. Required for user-specific features like wants list and collection management.
